versions.content: Semi-static DHCP server configuration In order to be able to assign always the same IP-address to a dedicated DHCP client, the DHCP server needs the information at which switch port the DHCP request with the specific MAC ad- dress has been received. With this switch port information the DHCP server will assign the IP-address according to the VlanMembership . dhcpAddressAssignment . 113 of 1928  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 63: AUTOSAR_TPS_SystemTemplate System Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 This allows the assignment of MAC addresses by the Tier 1 and assignment of IP addresses by the OEM. With this mechanism it is also possible to assign different IP addresses to several VLANs at the same port.
